description: This PHP source file defines the EducationAPI class which provides REST API endpoints for managing Education records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete), validation rules, and integration with underlying services and data models related to Education entities.

classes.name: EducationAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for managing Education records, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting education entities within the HR system. It extends the Endpoint class and implements the CrudEndpoint interface, offering standardized CRUD functionality with validation and service integration.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Education record based on the provided ID, returning a resource result with the education data or throwing a not found exception.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of the EducationService used to access Education data operations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' request, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of all Education records, applying sorting and pagination, and returns the data along with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing Education records, primarily for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Education record, initializes the Education entity, saves it, and returns the newly created resource.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Populates the Education entity with data from the request and saves it via the EducationService.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new Education, primarily validating the 'name' parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Education record identified by ID, saves changes, and returns the updated resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an Education, including ensuring the ID is positive and 'name' is unique.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the 'name' parameter, enforcing string type, length, and entity uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more Education records based on provided IDs, and returns the list of deleted IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation, ensuring the input is an array of integers.
